subject: DatHarbor: model-fit follow-up + prompt sample request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@dataharbor.com>; Samir Rao <samir@datacounsel.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 16:52:00 -0800
Subject: DatHarbor: model-fit follow-up + prompt sample request

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can scope a short eval: 

Recap (high level)
- Primary goal: surface structured summaries and named-entity-normalized outputs from customer support transcripts and contracts (search + summarize + normalized entities).
- Key constraints: some transcripts include PII/PHI; you prefer private deployment if we handle any PHI; latency target ~250ms median for short responses.
- Success metrics you care about: entity F1 on our labeled set, hallucination rate on contract clauses, and throughput/cost at 10 QPS.

Initial model recommendations
- Candidate A (fast dev path): redwood/romeo-chat-7b-q4f16 (quantized variant we benchmarked for short-turn summarization).
- Candidate B (higher quality): open/llama-2.0-chat-13b with Redwood-optimized kernels (better entity preservation on long context).
- Fallback: smaller distill for secondary routing in low-cost mode.

What we need from you to run a pragmatic eval (see attached prompt-capture-template.csv + redaction-guidelines.pdf):
1) 50–150 representative prompts (real customer utterances or query examples). Aim for a mix: 60% routine, 30% edge-case (legalese, long contracts), 10% intentionally adversarial/noisy.
2) Mark each prompt row with a sensitivity flag (PHI, PII, public) and a short label for the expected output form (e.g., "entity-normalized JSON", "one-paragraph summary", "bulleted action items").
3) Pull 10 annotated edge cases with the expected correct output where possible (we’ll use these for quick regression checks).

Redaction guidance (quick)
- If prompts contain 1:1 identifiers (SSNs, account numbers), replace with <REDACTED_SSN> and mark sensitivity.
- For PHI we recommend either: a) send sanitized examples via S3 with customer-managed KMS, or b) run evaluation in a Private deployment copy (we can provision a short-lived Private eval).

Timeline
- If we get the prompt CSV and 10 edge cases by EOD Wed (Nov 19), we’ll produce an initial model-fit report and short eval artifacts within 5 business days.

Action items
- Nora: confirm which delivery option you prefer for sensitive examples (S3 with CMK vs Private eval).
- Samir: point us to any compliance guardrails we should follow (HIPAA specifics, DPA clauses).
- Jordan/Ben: will stand up the benchmark harness and baseline configs; Marissa will run basic prompt-sensitivity scans.

Attachments referenced: prompt-capture-template.csv (CSV template), redaction-guidelines.pdf (short guidance).

Open to a quick 20-min follow-up tomorrow if that helps — I can send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Nora Patel <nora@dataharbor.com>

Cc: Samir Rao <samir@datacounsel.io>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:03:15 -0800
Subject: Re: DatHarbor: model-fit follow-up + prompt sample request

Thanks Jordan — this all looks good. A couple quick clarifying questions before we start pulling examples:

1) For the sensitivity flag, do you want us to replace PII inline in the CSV or keep original and upload to a secure S3 location?
2) On PHI: we are covered under a BA with our clinical partners; we need to be explicit about whether any temporary storage will be encrypted at rest and who holds keys.

If you can confirm today we’ll start collecting examples — I expect to have an initial 40 prompts by EOD Wed. Also looping Samir for legal/compliance context.

— Nora
Nora Patel
Head of Product
DataHarbor
nora@dataharbor.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@dataharbor.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 11:45:30 -0800
Subject: Re: DatHarbor: model-fit follow-up + prompt sample request

Hi Nora — quick answers from the security/ops side: 

- Prefer option B (Private eval) for any PHI-containing examples. We can provision a short-lived Private eval in your VPC or in our Private preview; all data will be encrypted in transit and at rest, and keys can be customer-managed via KMS.
- If you need to provide sanitized examples in the CSV (no PHI), that’s fine for the majority of prompts; mark any sanitized rows with SANI flag.
- We have a PHI-handling checklist; attaching PHI-handling-checklist.docx for your compliance team.

Redaction note (practical regex examples we use internally):
- SSN-like: "( \d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4} )" -> replace with <REDACTED_SSN>
- Emails: detect via simple email regex and replace with <REDACTED_EMAIL> before upload if you can.

We’ll also include SOC 2 options and can identify the minimal scope for HIPAA with your legal team.

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@dataharbor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Samir Rao <samir@datacounsel.io>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:10:05 -0800
Subject: Re: DatHarbor: model-fit follow-up + prompt sample request

Perfect — thanks for the quick responses. Proposed mutual action plan and dates: 

- Wed Nov 19: DataHarbor sends 40–80 sanitized prompts + 10 annotated edge cases. If you prefer Private eval, confirm by EOD Wed and we’ll provision (eta 24–48 hrs).
- Mon Nov 24: Redwood delivers initial model-fit report (benchmarks, recommended config, sample outputs).
- Week of Dec 1: Joint review and decision on pilot scope (dedicated vs hosted).

I’ve also created a lightweight benchmark page with the configurations we plan to run (link below). When you send the CSV, include a short column that lists the expected canonical output: that will speed up automated scoring.

Calendar: I’m free Thu 20th 10:30–11:00 or Fri 21st 14:00–14:30 PT — will send a short invite unless you prefer a different time.

Links: https://redwood.app/benchmarks/dataharbor-eval-2025 

Thanks — looking forward to the sample set.

Jordan
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
